RPE is Rate of Perceived Exertion, a 1 to 10 scale for how hard a set felt. A 10 means you couldn't have done another rep, a 9 means you had one left, an 8 means about two left, and so on.

It's useful because it lets you match effort to the day instead of chasing a fixed number. Most working sets land around 7 to 9, which leaves you room to keep progressing without grinding every set to failure.

If you want, I can look at how your recent sets have been going and where that puts you.
